segments.text: It's crazy how you want me now that I don't want you I know you are Jason
You think you're a nice guy because you do the bare minimum
But you're actually an insecure evil weirdo if you weren't so hot I chopped all your fingers off
So you'd go crazy and no girl would ever find you again
But I'm gonna do that to you because I'm a good person unlike you
Know what I deserve that I deserve that
